Name:           conditional
Version:        3.1.0
Release:        1.fc42
Summary:        A test package with conditional sources
License:        MIT
URL:            https://example.com/conditional



Source0:        https://example.com/conditional/conditional-3.1.0.tar.gz

Source1:        https://example.com/conditional/bundled-deps.tar.gz


%description
A test package whose Source1 is only present when the "bundled" bcond is enabled.

%prep
cd '/home/shebert/rpmbuild/BUILD/conditional-3.1.0-build'
rm -rf 'conditional-3.1.0'
/usr/lib/rpm/rpmuncompress -x 'tests/fixtures/specs/conditional-3.1.0.tar.gz'
STATUS=$?
if [ $STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
  exit $STATUS
fi
cd 'conditional-3.1.0'
/usr/bin/chmod -Rf a+rX,u+w,g-w,o-w .


%build

%install

%files

%changelog
* Mon Jan 01 2024 Test <test@example.com> - 3.1.0-1
- Initial package
